entry.title: MS2KR 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **MS2KR for MPC**: the MS2000R analog-modeling synth as a plugin instrument for MPC Gen2 standalones (MPC Live III and other aarch64 MPCs) on MPC OS 3.10 or later. It runs the synth's own firmware on an emulated main CPU and DSP (ms2000r-emu by Tuth), so programs, vocoder, arpeggiator, mod sequencer and effects behave like the hardware. - Six-tab touchscreen skin laid out like the front panel (PLAY, BANKS, OSC, FILTER/EG, LFO/FX/PATCH, ARP/SEQ), Q-Link control, the LCD live on e
